'''Palola''', also known as '''Palo''', was a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During a [[Battle of Ereesus|battle]] on [[Ereesus]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Palola's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, Palola and his men were rescued by a team led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sollaw ap-Orwien]].
